card.name: Spots before a partitive quantity
card.fires_on: Points where the next word is likely a quantity or partitive such as 'some of which', 'any of these', 'one of them', or a number of states or items. It fires on commas, spaces, or short linking words just before that quantity.

modes.label: Comma before 'some/most of which'
modes.description: A comma after a plural noun phrase, where a relative clause like 'some of which' or 'most of which' follows.
modes.example: This high-speed impact creates a shower of particles<<,>> some of which decay to neutrinos.

modes.label: Before a count of states or items
modes.description: The gap just before a number of states or items, often at the start of a sentence or after a year.

modes.label: Inside 'not one / at least one / any of'
modes.description: A word in a phrase that leads into 'one of them' or 'any of these'.

card.plain: It marks spots where the text is about to say how many or which of a group, such as 'several of them'.
